t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Orange, Green, red, blue gnomes are light forest, remaining are dark. figure out which forest has more mushrooms. always focus on 5x. placement and size are irrelevent.

vb_textbox.text: The Gnomes appear in pairs, Orange & Brown, Red & Yellow, Blue & Purple, Green & Pink. Their positions may vary, but they always appear in these pairs. Each Gnome in a pair takes you to a different forest, Orange, Red, Blue and Green take you to a light forest, while Brown, Yellow, Purple and Pink take you to the darker forest. Your goal is to consistently reach the forest with the most mushrooms, however the number of mushrooms in each forest always changes. This is all true regardless of point multipliers.
